import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Stress Level\n(Size = Physical Activity)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Duration by Occupation
occupation_order = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Occupation', y='Sleep Duration', ax=axes[0, 1], order=occupation_order)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Variables
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=axes[0, 2])
axes[0, 2].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Sleep Quality by BMI Category and Gender
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', 
            ax=axes[1, 0], order=bmi_order, palette='Set2')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality by BMI Category and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Gender')

# 5. Daily Steps Distribution by Sleep Disorder
sleep_disorder_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].notna()]
if not sleep_disorder_data.empty:
    sns.violinplot(data=sleep_disorder_data, x='Sleep Disorder', y='Daily Steps', 
                   ax=axes[1, 1], palette='muted', inner='quartile')
    axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 1].set_title('Daily Steps Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
else:
    axes[1, 1].text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Sleep Disorder Data Available', 
                    ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 1].set_title('Daily Steps Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Age Distribution by Occupation with Sleep Duration overlay
for occupation in df['Occupation'].unique():
    occupation_data = df[df['Occupation'] == occupation]
    axes[1, 2].scatter(occupation_data['Age'], occupation_data['Occupation'], 
                       s=occupation_data['Sleep Duration']*20, alpha=0.6, 
                       label=occupation, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Age Distribution by Occupation\n(Size = Sleep Duration)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].legend(title='Occupation', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
